{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Count how many rows have revenue_clean == 999999.99
qa_count = (df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99).sum()

print(f"Number of rows with revenue_clean == 999999.99: {qa_count}")"}
